modules.description: UDisks2 add-on modules to activate. Common values: lvm2 (LVM volume groups), btrfs (Btrfs subvolumes), iscsi (iSCSI targets), zram (compressed RAM block devices). Leave empty on systems that need none.

items.description: Module name as it appears in the udisks2 module directory, without path or extension (e.g. lvm2).

modules_load_preference.description: Controls when listed modules are initialised. 'ondemand' defers loading until the module is first referenced (lower startup cost); 'onstartup' loads all listed modules when the daemon starts (avoids first-use latency).

encryption.description: Default LUKS encryption format used when creating new encrypted volumes. 'luks2' (LUKS2) is the modern standard with stronger key derivation and metadata integrity; use 'luks1' only if legacy boot loaders or old distros must unlock the volume.
